mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the apparatus to the lungs was most worthwhile because the result explained how diaphragm contraction draws air in and elastic recoil helps air flow out.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed attempt to attach the pleural membranes directly to the circulation was least satisfying because it gave no indication of the required order.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the rib cage had to join the pleural membranes before the diaphragm; the compatibility feedback revealed that step.

arbitrary.text: The required assembly order felt somewhat arbitrary at first: the lung and membrane descriptions suggested a connection, but the attempted combination gave no explanation for why it was unavailable.

continue.text: I would continue into another chapter: connecting the breathing muscles, control pathway and lungs made me curious how the body systems will be brought together next.
